scope: Early adoption timing answer; implementation and runtime verification incomplete. Not a completed importer review.
answer_first: A separately pinned supplemental entry/executor can be added after generation while retaining the generated policy, core, wrapper, entry and config bytes. Static identity expressions permit this; runtime proof is pending. Do not edit the wrapper: its byte SHA is an input to cache_id. No evidence currently requires inclusion in verdict-day generation.
tested: Static source inspection of generator, wrapper identity expressions and executor/ingest control flow.
SHA256 computed from source bytes for the attached pins.
untested: Runtime identity equality on generated v006r12_c4 chain
Production execution and all scientific run data
findings: Wrapper Context cache_id includes the wrapper file hash and guard file hash, plus parent identity and certificate policy.
Ledger genesis uses schema, certificate_registry and certificate_ledger. Unchanged inputs preserve its digest.

Validated WAVE cache entries retain original provenance call_dir and result_path; observed verification does not mandate wave-local custody. Source WAVE must describe the natural request, with explicit external execution origin.
Cache.put alone is insufficient: run_wave calls executor.execute before ingest; resume does not skip an externally cached planned call.

Hook must run only after genuine committed WAVE_PLAN under the existing work-dir lock. Must retain original direct call directory and normal fallback execution for unmatched requests. Mixed-wave indexing/resume semantics remain unresolved.
No F6 automatic admission. Root per-call judgment and latest acceptance semantics must remain enforced.
